props.title: New bank details before Friday’s payment
props.markdown:
**From:** Accounts, Harlow Tyres `accounts@harlow-tyres-billing.com`

Hello, our bank has changed. Please pay this week’s invoice (£18,400) to the account below and confirm today, so the payment is not delayed.

IBAN: GB33 BUKB 2020 1555 5555 55

props.prompt: You work in Finance. What do you do?

options.label: Press Report, and leave the payment as it is
options.feedback: **Right.** It asks for money, in a hurry, from an address Harlow has never used. Report sends it to the desk; if the change were real, Finance would confirm it by calling Harlow on the number already on file.

options.label: Reply and ask them to confirm the change
options.feedback: **Not this.** Your reply goes to the attacker, who will gladly confirm. Report the email; a real change is checked by calling the supplier on the number already on file, never one in the email.

options.label: Forward it to your manager so they can decide
options.feedback: **Not this.** Forwarding passes the lure to someone who can approve the payment. Report it: the desk checks it in minutes and warns Finance if needed.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: Your turn. This email reached Finance this morning. What do you do?
